title: Great app
body: Great app for anyone wanting to kick bad habits. I used this to help me quit smoking and I when I reached 24 months smoke free I used it to quit alcohol. It shows your progress in hours, days, months and years which is really cool to track progress and motivating and if you fall short you just reset and start again- this feature was particularly helpful and motivating when i eventually quit alcohol cause I could see all my resets and how far I’ve come.They also have banners of your progress that you can share on social media resized to the correct specs which was cool. Currently using the free version and I have kicked about 6 habits I suspect the more you add you’ll need to start paying. Great app, highly recommend

title: Simple and fit for purpose
body:
If you find the question “When last did …?”  comes up quite often for your, then this app is for you. 

When last did I change the battery of my car?
When last was my car last serviced?
When last was my wedding anniversary?
When last was my last ski trip? 
When last did I take the kids to the zoo, or treat my partner to a SPA outing or …. 

Love this app, easy to use and can take care of both your serious and fun “When lasts” 😀
